title: Images and long text through encoders
description: Photos or long documents labelled by a team: an encoder turns each into numbers a model can read.
question: Which decisions does DCLab reach on a images and long text through encoders problem (Photos or long documents labelled by a team: an encoder turns each into numbers a model can read), and do they hold?
hypothesis: Each decision a careful data scientist reaches on this kind of problem holds on every seed of the kind's replica.
setup_summary: The images and long text through encoders kind's replica on seeds 0, 1, 2, brought as a person would; its own machine in dclab_core solve it, and each decision is checked on the finished run. No model is called.

limitations: Invented replicas with planted traps, three seeds: what the kind decides, not how well it does on real data.
Checks on one seed share its data, so they are not independent: the interval over seeds is the honest one.
